goal: Make me a small Python desktop email assistant called Ghost-box that runs locally on my Mac. I want to connect one Gmail or Outlook account at a time, explicitly fetch messages for a date range, browse them, search the downloaded mail by text with sender and date filters, and select messages to summarize or ask questions about using a local model. Keep downloaded emails and derived results in RAM rather than an email database. Searches and answers must make the local coverage clear; finding nothing in downloaded mail must not claim that no such email exists anywhere. Summarization should receive only the selected messages and answers should retain references to their source messages. Keep the window responsive during fetches and generation, show progress and useful errors, and let me cancel work. Let me choose a local MLX or GGUF model, reuse it for follow-ups, unload it manually or after five idle minutes, and clear downloaded mail and derived results explicitly. Changing accounts must not mix the old account's mail into the new one. No background synchronization or automatic sending is needed. Give me a practical single-window app with setup and run instructions, not just isolated functions.

tasks.title: Specify RAM-only account separation, deduplication and explicit clearing.
acceptance: Repeated IDs do not duplicate messages.
Separate accounts and fresh stores remain isolated.
Clear removes messages and coverage.

tasks.title: Specify downloaded-only search and Unicode-aware sender filters.
acceptance: A known sender matches under the declared Turkish-aware fold.
Empty or absent queries produce no invented matches.
A sender-only filter never matches text found only in the body or subject.

tasks.title: Specify lossless bounded splitting of selected message bodies.
acceptance: Concatenating all parts reproduces the exact Unicode body.
IDs remain unchanged and part numbers are consecutive.
Exceeding the maximum task count raises TaskError rather than dropping content.

tasks.title: Specify source-bound quotation checking with valid and invalid controls.
acceptance: An own-body quotation is accepted.
A fact borrowed from another email raises TaskError.
An unclear item may use the declared empty classification quote.

tasks.title: Specify explicit provider fetching and truthful downloaded-range coverage.
acceptance: Reading messages never initiates fetching.
Explicit fetch forwards account and timezone-aware dates and deduplicates IDs.
A narrower search retains the downloaded coverage range even when no results match.

tasks.title: Specify combined filters, selected-only inference and citation validation.
acceptance: Date and sender filters both exclude downloaded rows.
Answer and summary receive only selected rows.
Empty, unknown or foreign-citation selections are rejected without extra model calls.

tasks.title: Specify cancellation and account-epoch protection for delayed callbacks.
acceptance: A cancelled callback cannot replace the current result.
A valid current callback is accepted.
Changing account clears results and rejects old-account callbacks.

tasks.title: Specify model reuse, manual unload and activity-aware idle boundaries.
acceptance: Repeated loads reuse the same path.
Clear removes derived content.
299.99 seconds does not unload; 300 seconds does.
Active operations prevent idle unloading and completion resets the timer.

acceptance: Native-window responsiveness, real provider authentication and actual model loading remain manual integration checks.
